title.narrative: Uttarakhand Emergency Assistance Project

description.narrative: The emergency loan will help economic and social recovery in Uttarakhand in the aftermath of the June 2013 disaster. The outcome will be the rehabilitation of basic public and social infrastructure, as well as improvements to disaster preparedness, project management and institutional effectiveness.
